overview: A second femtosecond TDTR line with wavelength-separated pump and probe optics. Independent optical channels support flexible filtering and detector selection for samples with different transducer reflectance and optical backgrounds.
overviewZh: 第二套飞秒 TDTR 光路采用波长分离的泵浦与探测通道，可根据不同金属传感层的反射率和光学背景灵活配置滤光与探测器。
principle: Pump and probe use distinct wavelengths, separated by wavelength-selective optics. Pump pulses heat the transducer; the probe samples reflectance at controlled delays. Model fitting extracts thermal properties within the sample's sensitivity window. Wavelength separation reduces pump leakage but does not eliminate fluorescence or all optical backgrounds.
principleZh: 泵浦与探测光采用不同波长，并通过选波光学元件分离。泵浦脉冲加热金属传感层，探测光在受控延迟下读取反射率变化；结合热模型，在样品灵敏度窗口内反演热物性。波长分离可降低泵浦串扰，但不能保证消除荧光等全部光学背景。
